card.line: Nob was a city of the priests near Jerusalem, where David found help while running from Saul and where Saul later had the priests killed.

moments.title: David Gets Bread and a Sword
moments.text: David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest, while fleeing from Saul. Ahimelech gave him the consecrated bread, and later gave him the sword of Goliath.

moments.title: Doeg Tells Saul
moments.text: Doeg the Edomite told Saul he had seen David come to Ahimelech at Nob. Saul then called Ahimelech and the priests' families to come to him.

moments.title: Saul Destroys the City of Priests
moments.text: Saul ordered the priests killed, and Doeg struck them down. He also put Nob to the sword. Abiathar, a son of Ahimelech, escaped and fled to David.

moments.title: An Enemy Halts at Nob
moments.text: Isaiah says an enemy army will stop at Nob and shake a fist at Jerusalem. Then the LORD will cut down the mighty with terrifying power.
